A few things to know.

What is a training block?

A group of workouts for a set number of weeks or cycles. With Block Pro, choose training days and an optional deload week. Today shows the session to lift next. Without Pro, you can keep workouts in folders.

What do the lamps mean?

With Pro, a set with targets gets feedback on reps, load, and effort. White is a pass. Red is a miss, with the reason shown. Read about lamps and next targets.

Which iPhones can use Block?

Block supports iOS 17 and later. The AI trainer needs iOS 27 and Block Pro. Connected assistants use your assistant's own app.

Can I bring my history and delete my account?

You can import from Hevy for free. Delete your Block account and training data in Settings at any time. Deleting an account does not cancel an Apple subscription. The privacy policy explains how your data is handled.
